newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian shares move higher, activity dips.
newsitem.headline: Estonian shares move higher, activity dips.

text.p: The index of the Estonian share market moved slightly higher on Friday although activity was lower than at previous sessions.
The Tallinn stock exchange index rose by 0.89 percent to 159.25 and volume on the official list came to 23.4 million kroons compared with 46.6 million kroons on Thursday.

Leading bank Hansapank led the main list with trade of 8.6 million kroons but its shares dipped to 161 kroons from 162. Other bank shares also dropped, with Union Bank falling to 28.75 kroons from 29.60 and Savings Bank down to 65.60 kroons from 65.25.
News that Sweden's Sparbanken had bought 12.5 percent in Savings Bank came too late for the market.
On the secondary market, Norma dominated as it traded 5.5 million kroons and rose slightly to 36.50 kroons from 36.10.
It earlier predicted full-year 1997 profits of 50.2 million kroons versus expected 1996 profits of 62 million.
Tallinn Department Store was also active at 2.9 million kroons and it rose to 77.35 kroons from 76.50. It earlier announced that it had bought a department store in the southern town of Tartu.
